bio: I'm Shantanu, a backend-first full-stack developer based in Surat, Gujarat. My home ground is C#, ASP.NET Core Web API, Entity Framework Core and SQL Server, and I also build the Angular and React front ends that sit on top of those APIs, so I can take a feature from the database schema all the way to the screen.

I started in 2022 as an Angular intern at WeeTech Solution, turning UI/UX designs into responsive interfaces and wiring them to REST APIs. Later that year I joined ProjectTree as a Junior Software Engineer on ASP.NET MVC and Angular apps, and within a few months moved up to Full Stack Developer, the role I've held for over four years.

At ProjectTree I build enterprise applications that people use every day: an Event Registration System with real-time seat availability and payments, an Event Management Platform with scheduling and automated notifications, an internal HelpDesk with role-based ticket routing and SLA tracking, and Leave Management workflows that replaced manual approvals.

I treat performance and security as features rather than afterthoughts. Refactoring SQL Server queries and adding Redis caching cut our API response times by 40%, and JWT authentication, role-based authorization and secrets kept in HashiCorp Vault go in from the first commit. Builds and releases run through Jenkins and Azure DevOps pipelines, with Docker where it fits.

Beyond my own code, I mentor junior developers through code reviews and pair programming on .NET and Angular best practices. I'm certified in Claude Code, so AI-assisted development is part of my everyday workflow, and outside work I build side projects such as MyAML, a JSON config builder in Angular 20 that lets non-technical teams create valid config files from a simple form.

I enjoy clean, readable code, APIs that are fast and safe by default, and interfaces that just make sense. If you're looking for a .NET and Angular developer who cares about both ends of the stack, I'd love to hear from you.
